description: Rothco’s Camp Stove Folding Wind Screen provides all-encompassing wind protection that insulates your stove flame so you can cook with confidence at your campsite. This camping accessory is designed to help preserve fuel efficiency and boil and cooking times in the wilderness. The windscreen features 12 panels held together by aluminum rods that are removable to adapt to the size of your camp stove (Each panel measures 9.5 inches x 3.25 inches x 1/16 inches). Two nine-inch aluminum stakes on each end keep the camping stove windscreen secure around your flame. .25-inch indents at the bottom of each panel of the portable camp windscreen enhance air circulation to optimize fuel use. A convenient carrying pouch is included for easy packing, the lightweight windscreen is perfect for camping, backpacking, and more.
